data.synopsis: The transcription factor AhANT is affiliated with weights and dimensions of seeds and pods in peanut, with trait values impacted by changes in protein sequence.
AhBSK1, belonging to the Brassinosteroid-Signaling Kinase family, is a candidate gene helping to regulate shoot branching habits and runner vs erect architecture in cultivated peanut.
AhWRI1, an ethylene-responsive transcription factor, is highly expressed in seeds and pods and is associated with oil content and fatty acid composition in cultivated peanut.
